scope: Throwaway apps/console only; presentation simplification, no backend policy or production apps/web changes.
owner: apps/console presentation; all commands still use existing client and write-intent contracts.
changes: Runtime settings default to total concurrency; advanced scheduling, protection and current values are collapsed.
Channel messages and instance state remain primary; memory, tasks, legacy import and diagnostics open on demand. Stopped emergency state exposes recovery.
Role revision form appears only after selecting a role; internal identifiers live in details.
New channel needs only a name; optional stable slug generated once before the frozen write intent.
Recognizable historical test/acceptance names filtered from channel and Role lists by default, with explicit reveal checkbox. Not deletion, archiving or a new backend state.

testRecordBoundary.classification: Explicit name patterns, a convenience filter only; can hide a similarly named user record until checkbox selected.

verification.tdd: Old UI failed browser assertion that only total concurrency is visible; initial name classifier failed regression cases.
verification.unit: 62 console checks passed; name-only creation and reversible filter covered in browser gate.
verification.browser: Final fake-provider gate passed at 1440x1000 and 390x844; only one default runtime input, advanced controls accessible, name-only channel creation, reversible test-record filter, existing create/revise/instantiate/message/task/private-box/memory/settings/unknown-write/recovery workflows preserved.

limitations: Temporary console remains, not a product UI redesign.
Name filter is neither permission enforcement nor a reliable permanent test-data classification.
Historical records retained; apps/web list is unchanged.
